verdict: approve bounded diagnostic design with explicit implementation gates; not execution approval or product acceptance

assessment.minimality: Debugger return-value capture answers the unresolved original mdb_env_open error that a stage-only crash repeat cannot reliably preserve. Two pre-authorized sequential contrasts are reasonable, but second arm only after first completes successfully; stop at first error, timeout, mismatch or crash. A normal undebugged rerun is not a prerequisite.
assessment.priorEvidence: Run1 used legacy backend and demonstrated late failure partial commit; run2 lacked required native-v2 directory; run3 aborted in legacy open cleanup before ACIR. Nine simple v1/v2/mixed cycles passed, so mixed imports alone are not an established cause. Current selected generated cases add actual crypto/effect/store lifecycle absent from that matrix.
assessment.selection: Anchored expression selects exactly original wrong ordinal, wrong fee and wrong execution generated cases; wrong slot and all ACIR tests are excluded. ACIR=1 still executes top-level optional imports and artifact loading; this is the intended contrast, not an ACIR execution claim.
assessment.sourcePins: All five plan source/binary hashes checked and matched.
assessment.offsets: Independent static nm/otool confirms EnvWrap::openEnv file address0x5a674, bl _mdb_env_open at0x5a8ac (entry+0x238), following str w0 at0x5a8b0 (entry+0x23c). Capturing signed32 w0 before that instruction preserves return result. Source constant EXISTING_ENV_FOUND is10.
assessment.interpretation: Unexpected nonzero result is native return code, not automatically POSIX errno. Negative LMDB codes must remain numeric until source-backed interpretation. Two passing arms leave cause unresolved; altered debugger timing/test isolation cannot establish absence of full-suite interaction.

requiredHelperGates: Freeze and independently review evidence-only generator/LLDB callback/supervisor before execution; exact insertion inventory and test hashes must be recorded.

Verify actual pinned Node and addon hashes, exact module identity and loaded instruction/symbol offset before breakpoints; refuse unresolved/multiple/changed module bindings. Never use fixed ASLR addresses.
Require exactly three selected tests complete per successful arm and explicit stage order; no zero-test/skip-only success. ACIR utility invocation count must remain zero.

On return code outside0/10 stop before cleanup, persist numeric record, classify diagnostic stop rather than passing test, and reap all owned descendants. No return-register writes or continuation through a failure.
Preserve20s/arm60s total4GiB256KiB logs, immediate stop on failure and no retries. Refused debugger attachment is blocked evidence, not grounds to alter permissions/SIP.
Own and verify cleanup of LLDB, inferior and asynchronous BB descendants by process ancestry as well as group; no blanket process killing.
Record fsynced finite stages and fixed numeric metadata only. No generic debugger register dumps, argument/path extraction, raw environment or memory dumps.

Preserve no-isolation topology difference and all historical failures; neither this diagnostic nor simple matrix qualifies native-v2 late-store rollback, actual IndexedDB wallet or full cold recovery.
executedDuringReview: Only source reads, hashes and static nm/otool inspection; no debugger, Node test, native addon, compiler, network or chain execution.
next: After helper source approval and lead slot grant, first arm may run. The second is conditional on first successful cleanup. Do not launch a fourth full suite merely because both arms pass.
